US8509827B2.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.

Context-Data Acquisition And Ranking.description: A method and system in which a context-data type is determined from a query, context-data sources providing that type are identified, a request for context data is generated, and received context data may be ranked according to a specified parameter.

Context-Data Type.description: A classification of context data determined from a query or from the meaning of a term of a short message, providing information about an environment of a mobile device.

Context-Data Source.description: A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested; sources may be ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost.

Context Data.description: Data of a determined context-data type that is received from a context-data source, ranked according to a specified parameter, and provided to devices or associated with short messages.

Short Message.description: A message generated by a mobile device and received by a server, whose term meanings are used to determine a context-data type; context data may be appended to or encoded into the short message.

Mobile Device.description: A device that generates a short message or query and to which received context data may be provided; its state may serve as a specified parameter.

Server.description: A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data type determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.

Recipient Mobile Device.description: A mobile device that receives context data, short messages with appended context data, or a URI of a database server.

Specified Parameter.description: A criterion used to rank context-data sources or received context data, including pecuniary cost, state of the receiving mobile device, and state of an available communication network.

Pecuniary Cost.description: A cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a specified parameter for algorithmically ranking context-data sources.

Database.description: A database available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.

Database Server.description: A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to access stored context data.

Uniform Resource Identifier.description: An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device.

Markup Language.description: A language used to encode received context data into a short message.

Metadata Instructions.description: Instructions appended to a short message to query a database for received context data.
